name: Show Person or Org Slide
purpose: Focuses the organization name field if the party is an organization, otherwise the first name field.

name: Open Party Info Card { Id }
purpose: Opens the 'Edit Contact' card window for a party id (JSON parameter 'Id') and finds the Party; closes the window with a 'could not be found' dialog on error. Does nothing when no Id is passed.

name: Create Customer

name: Create Employee
purpose: Creates an employee: calls karbon_kontroller '_wip_Create Employee' (164) with PartySubtype Person, DisplayName 'New Employee' and SkipValidations true, shows an error dialog on failure, then finds the new Employee on a layout.
open_question: Step 17 goes to a layout that no longer exists (<unknown>, id 57), so the find lands on the current layout or fails. Script is in the Scripts menu; callers: none found.

name: Open Party Detail { Id }
purpose: Goes to layout 'Party Detail', resizes to fit and, if an Id was passed in JSON, finds that Party (dialog 'contact could not be found' on failure). Does nothing further when Id is empty.
callers: none found (may be called by name)

name: Party Detail - On Record Load
purpose: On-record-load trigger of Party Detail: clears selector::ActivityId.

name: btn: Open Create Party Card - All Contacts
purpose: Clears selector::PartyId, installs a 1-second OnTimer that calls 'OnTimer: Handle Create Party From All Contacts' (620) and opens the 'Create Party' card (script 184).
open_question: Combination of timer + card is the way the create result is handed back to the list.

name: OnTimer: Handle Create Party From All Contacts
purpose: OnTimer handler: stops the timer, takes the new Organization or Person id from UtilityParty and opens the contact detail (script 502) with that Id.
open_question: If neither id exists the Else branch is empty (comment '#error'), so nothing happens. Script is in the Scripts menu.
